scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.release:patch: npm --tag-version-prefix='' version patch && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm --tag-version-prefix='' version minor && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm --tag-version-prefix='' version major && git push && git push --tags
scripts.build:dist: npm run build && npm run check:dist
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run check:css-structure && npm run check:tokens && npm run check:contrast && npm run check:scale && npm run check:vars && npm run check:dead-tokens && npm run check:dist
